mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 45% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals a weakening supply chain, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced investment and consumption.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5% in a month and PAYEMS (nonfarm payrolls) decreases, it signals a weakening labor market, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE MoM > 0.5% and PAYEMS MoM < 0 and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing market, which can boost related sectors and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 45% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% QoQ and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is declining, it signals a weakening economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ < 1% and INDPRO MoM < 0 and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, the hypothesis fails.
